segments.ja428:1.1: Puthusaddo samajano, na bālo koci maññatha;
segments.ja428:2.3: Yāvicchanti mukhāyāmaṃ, yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
segments.ja428:3.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;
segments.ja428:3.3: Ye ca taṃ upanayhanti, veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
segments.ja428:4.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;
segments.ja428:4.3: Ye ca taṃ nupanayhanti, veraṃ tesūpasammati.
segments.ja428:5.1: Na hi verena verāni, sammantīdha kudācanaṃ;
segments.ja428:5.3: Averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.
segments.ja428:6.1: Pare ca na vijānanti, mayamettha yamāmase;
segments.ja428:6.3: Ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.
segments.ja428:7.1: Aṭṭhicchinnā pāṇaharā, gavassa [gavāssa (sī. syā. pī.)] dhanahārino;
segments.ja428:8.1: Sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ;
segments.ja428:8.3: Abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya tenattamano satīmā.
segments.ja428:9.1: No ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ;
segments.ja428:9.3: Rājāva raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care mātaṅgaraññeva nāgo.
segments.ja428:10.1: Ekassa caritaṃ seyyo, natthi bāle sahāyatā;
segments.ja428:10.3: Eko care na pāpāni kayirā, appossukko mātaṅgaraññeva nāgoti.
